evidence.detail: Surfaced while building the cb-tut annotated wiki (composablebeliefs/cb-tut). A dedicated docs-vs-code audit cross-checked every docs/ essay against lib/cb/belief.ex, the mix tasks, and the live graph via mix bs. It confirmed the executable spine (eval-ledger, run-manifest, codepaths, mental-model, worked-example-eval-verdict, and both CI-gated compiled CLAUDE.mds) is accurate, and isolated the drift to three patterns: superseded-id rot (b060 to b065 in reference and mental-model, b043 to b066 in belief-graph), legacy essays predating the 2026-06-10 four-type schema (actualization.md README-linked and undisclaimed, the thesis body, cb-on-the-beam.md's nonexistent bs verbs), and undocumented surfaces (cb.retract, cb.repoint, cb.resolve, the okf.* tasks, plus a phantom /assert-session skill named in three docs). The full findings render as cb-tut page 19 and research/notes/docs-eval.md in that repo.
